dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the maximum width of the mid-body toward the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Relatively smooth lateral margins with a slight symmetrical inward taper at the cranial-cervical junction.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse grey mottling across the mid-dorsal and posterior regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, soft-gradient transitions between light-grey baseline and darker pigmented mottled patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Visible pale, linear rake marks on the left lateral-dorsal plane and lower posterior region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear scarring (rake marks) on the mid-to-lower dorsal surface; prominent dark circular aperture at the cranial apex (blowhole).
